taxPaidDate.description: Date tax was paid or became payable. Used when no invoice is issued (e.g. a receipt). ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name.description: Supplier name or the name under which it does business.

gstHstNumber.description: GST/HST registration number: 9-digit BN, or BN + "RT" + 4 digits (e.g. 123456789RT0001).

province.description: Canadian province or territory (two-letter postal code).

name.description: Intermediary name or the name under which it does business.

intermediary.description: An intermediary in respect of the supply. SOR/91-45 s. 3 accepts the intermediary's name and registration number instead of the supplier's.

name.description: Recipient's name, or its duly authorized agent's or representative's name.

tradingName.description: Name under which the recipient does business.

quantity.description: Quantity. Exact decimal, up to 6 decimal places.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit. Number or decimal string (e.g. 1234.56 or "1,234.56"); at most 2 decimal places.

lineTotal.description: Line amount. Number or decimal string (e.g. 1234.56 or "1,234.56"); at most 2 decimal places.

taxStatus.description: GST/HST status as stated on the document. Omit when the document does not state it.

taxes.description: Taxes charged, one entry per tax.

type.description: Kind of tax. OTHER = a tax invoicelint does not classify (for example foreign VAT); it counts in the totals but not in GST/HST checks.

rate.description: Tax rate. In percent: 13 means 13%. Up to 4 decimal places.

taxableAmount.description: Amount the tax was computed on. Number or decimal string (e.g. 1234.56 or "1,234.56"); at most 2 decimal places.

amount.description: Tax amount. Number or decimal string (e.g. 1234.56 or "1,234.56"); at most 2 decimal places.

items.description: A tax charged on the invoice.

rate.description: Stated total tax rate. In percent: 13 means 13%. Up to 4 decimal places.

taxIncludedStatement.description: The document states that tax is included in the amounts (e.g. "total includes HST at 13%").

subtotal.description: Sum of the line amounts, before document-level allowances, charges and tax. Number or decimal string (e.g. 1234.56 or "1,234.56"); at most 2 decimal places.

allowanceTotal.description: Document-level allowances (discounts) in total, as a positive amount. They reduce the amount tax is charged on. Number or decimal string (e.g. 1234.56 or "1,234.56"); at most 2 decimal places.

chargeTotal.description: Document-level charges (for example freight) in total, as a positive amount. They add to the amount tax is charged on. Number or decimal string (e.g. 1234.56 or "1,234.56"); at most 2 decimal places.

total.description: Total amount paid or payable, including tax. Number or decimal string (e.g. 1234.56 or "1,234.56"); at most 2 decimal places.

title: invoicelint canonical invoice
description: The invoice shape invoicelint validates. Amounts are numbers or decimal strings; dates are YYYY-MM-DD.
